summary: Computes and clamps the scroll position of a cursor-based UI component. Reads the total cursor item count via MenuCursorCount_bc90 and the scroll range at this+0x114; writes this+0xEC as ((count-1) * step + range/2) / range, or 0 when the range is zero (division guard). The result is clamped into [0, count-1]. When count-1 is below the range (content fits the viewport), an auxiliary utility at 0047bd90 is invoked instead. Called by UIComponentScrollUpdate (0047b1e0) and sub_47BB40 (0047bb40).

local_names.this: cursor-based UI component owning the scroll state
local_names.v2: total cursor item count returned by MenuCursorCount_bc90
local_names.v4: count-1, the maximum valid scroll index
local_names.result: clamped scroll position read back from this+0xEC

operations.description: MenuCursorCount_bc90 returns the total cursor item count used as the scroll index upper bound
Division guard on the scroll range this+0x114: when zero, write scroll position 0 to this+0xEC instead of evaluating the weighted formula
Scroll formula: this+0xEC = ((count-1) * this+0x110 + this+0x114/2) / this+0x114, rounding by half-range before the division
Clamp this+0xEC into [0, count-1]: negative values are forced to 0 and values above count-1 are forced to count-1
If count-1 is less than the range this+0x114, return the result of the auxiliary adjustment utility at 0047bd90 instead of the scroll value
Otherwise return the clamped scroll position
Invoked by UIComponentScrollUpdate (0047b1e0) and sub_47BB40 (0047bb40) during cursor-scroll updates
